subject: general
question: Who among the following singers had a Guinness World Record for recording 28 songs in a single day? (As of December 2022.)
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kumar Sanu**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kumar Sanu** holds the **Guinness World Record** for** recording 28 songs in a single day**.
 
• He achieved this remarkable feat in **1993**, showcasing his exceptional talent and dedication to music.
 
• Kumar Sanu is one of the most popular playback singers in Bollywood, known for his melodious voice and numerous hit songs.
 
• His record remains a testament to his hard work and passion for music.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Kumar Sanu, born as **Kedarnath Bhattacharya**, started his singing career in the late 1980s and became a household name in the 1990s.
 
• He has won several awards, including the **Filmfare Award for Best Male Playback Singer **for **five consecutive years**.
 
• In addition to Hindi, Kumar Sanu has sung in various other languages, further showcasing his versatility as a singer.
 
• His contribution to Indian music has been immense, and he continues to be celebrated by fans around the world.
